concrete_capability_transition: CLI read-only status/inspection -> brownie run "<objective>" invokes the existing Rust runtime headless.run.drive journey-admission execution path with bounded human and JSON output

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Makes the primary CLI command a practical headless entrypoint by dispatching a general objective to the existing Rust runtime headless drive boundary.
Exercises runtime-owned task execution through headless.run.drive while keeping the CLI outside agent-loop policy and next-action decisions.
Keeps provider, tool, workspace, Mode Pack, replay, and permission enforcement inside the Rust runtime; the CLI only constructs a fixed bounded request and renders selected result fields.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development, agent_loop, and runtime_permission_enforcement by exposing the CLI primary run command through an existing Rust runtime execution boundary.
answers.new_capability: brownie run "<objective>" becomes executable and returns bounded runtime-owned ids, status, next action, closure, and completion preview metadata.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: CLI-3 only supports status, inspect task/run, and list tasks; it cannot admit or execute a new autonomous objective and current run returned unsupported-command.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: CLI Product DoD gap CLI-4 remains open, leaving the official primary command advertised but nonfunctional and preventing CLI product completion.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from CLI-1 parser/binary, CLI-2 runtime.status transport, and CLI-3 read-only inspection/list. This phase adds the first execution dispatch path.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The implementation uses the existing headless.run.drive runtime method and adds no runtime JSON-RPC method or protocol semantics.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It renders selected bounded fields from the runtime-owned HeadlessRunDriveResult and adds no report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, preview, or generic summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime semantics are unchanged; user-visible CLI behavior changes from unsupported run to fixed headless.run.drive dispatch through the Rust runtime authority boundary.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless callers can start a general objective without VSIX or raw JSON-RPC choreography, while still receiving runtime next-action metadata for follow-up.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes CLI Product DoD gap CLI-4 only and leaves CLI-5 through CLI-10 open for bounded follow-up phases.

exit_criteria: brownie run "<objective>" invokes headless.run.drive with fixed bounded params and succeeds on a valid runtime response

run params include explicit authorization, stable CLI session/journey/drive ids, expected_start_session_sequence 0, bounded advance budgets, bounded context budget, and task_start.goal equal to the objective
run params do not include caller-selected mode_id or CLI-owned Mode Pack policy
human output is bounded and selected, not a raw runtime transport dump
--json output is bounded and names the selected CLI run result, not a generic RPC response

runtime errors, malformed responses, mismatched ids, missing binary, timeouts, and invalid result shapes fail closed without exposing runtime payloads, paths, environment, stdout/stderr, prompts, file contents, or secrets
brownie resume remains nonexecuting in CLI-4
develop remains absent as a primary command
no runtime JSON-RPC method is added for this phase

The CLI validates the runtime result shape before printing selected bounded objective execution information.
behavior_evidence: Unit tests prove fixed headless.run.drive param construction and absence of CLI mode policy.
Integration tests use fake runtime processes to verify request construction, bounded human output, bounded JSON output, and fail-closed error handling.
An integration test invokes the real brownie-runtime binary for brownie run with a temp workspace.
cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, diagnostics guard, phase-value guard, product-completion guard, and VSIX checks remain required validation.
safety_boundary: CLI-4 adds no runtime JSON-RPC method and exposes no arbitrary JSON-RPC passthrough.
CLI-4 does not implement resume execution, a CLI-owned scheduler, or a second agent loop.
CLI-4 does not duplicate permission, replay, recovery, Mode Pack, Product DoD, product-completion, workspace mutation, ledger, provider, verifier, or agent-loop policy in the CLI.
CLI-4 does not expose raw prompts, provider responses, file contents, stdout/stderr payloads, commands, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, or secrets.
non_goals: No resume runtime behavior, mode-list runtime behavior, daemon lifecycle manager, TUI, REPL, shell integration, plugin system, or packaging release.
No CLI-owned workspace mutation, provider execution policy, controlled tool execution policy, verifier execution policy, network policy, git execution, or service control.
No generic inspect wrapper, RPC mirror, report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, preview, or summary surface.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected arbitrary JSON-RPC passthrough because the CLI must expose fixed workflow commands, not a raw RPC mirror.
Rejected adding new runtime RPC methods because existing headless.run.drive already owns the execution semantics.
Rejected implementing brownie resume in this phase because that is CLI-5 interruption/recovery work.
Rejected CLI-owned interpretation of permissions, replay, recovery, Mode Pack, Product DoD, workspace mutation, and next-action policy because Rust runtime authority remains invariant.
technical_debt: CLI-5 through CLI-10 remain open Product DoD gaps after CLI-4.
Runtime binary discovery, packaging, and command help polish can be hardened in CLI-8 without changing CLI-4 execution authority semantics.
next_capability_rationale: After CLI-4 lands, CLI-5 should add restart-safe brownie resume using runtime-owned progress and replay evidence.
Product completion is denied until all required CLI Product DoD gaps, blocking debt, and required_before_release debt are closed.
